thread:
Maria (PM): quick sync — pushed a PRD stub for the metering/quota surface. need alignment on metering semantics, billing mapping, and launch criteria. pinging folks.
Kevin (Eng): skimmed. two options: explicit per-metric (text_tokens vs embeddings) or a unified 'units' abstraction. prefer explicit metrics to keep billing & quotas transparent.
Ashley (Design): Figma mockups: https://figma.com/s/rd/metersurface. shows project-level slider + per-key overrides. will need short microcopy for "burst" and for combined-billing cases.
Samir (Billing): billing must reflect metering. current finance rules bill per 1k tokens and per 1k embeddings. confirm rounding rules (ceil to 1k).
Jordan (ProdOps): enforcement modes: soft (throttle + 429) and hard (deny + 403). default to soft for self-serve; admins can set hard block.
Maria (PM): suggested acceptance criteria:
1) API: GET/PUT /v1/quotas returning per-key and per-project limits and usage
2) UI: create/edit quotas, view usage, request increase CTA
3) Metering emits the same metric names used by billing
4) Fallback policy defined for Dedicated deployments
Elaine (Eng): compact API suggestion:
```
GET /v1/quotas?scope=key
Response: {"scope":"key","limits":[{"metric":"text_tokens","period":"1d","limit":100000}],"usage":[{"metric":"text_tokens","period":"1d","used":34567}]}
```
Keep payload small.
Kevin (Eng): edge: single request may produce multiple billable outputs (e.g., rerank -> embeddings + text). Need precedence to avoid double-billing. I suggest explicit header `X-Metering-Type` or server derives primary metric based on endpoint params.
Samir (Billing): agree on precedence rule. Implementation: if request yields multiple metrics, bill only the metric with highest priority. Proposed priority: embeddings > text_generation > classification. Document with examples.
Ashley (Design): will add a tooltip: "If a request produces multiple billable outputs, only the primary output is billed to avoid duplicate charges. See docs for precedence examples." legal wants concrete examples though.
Samir (Billing): legal ok but requires 3 doc examples with numbers.
Maria (PM): launch plan draft: internal beta (2 weeks) -> roll to top-10 customers -> monitor reconciliation alerts (billing vs metering) within 24h, tolerance <=1% discrepancy. Rollback: disable UI, keep API as-is.
Jordan (ProdOps): rollout: feature-flagged API + UI. start sandbox orgs, then ramp by org size. ensure quota metadata is replicated to Dedicated clusters.
Elaine (Eng): include rate/quota headers for client adaptivity. propose:
```
X-Quota-Limit: 1000
X-Quota-Remaining: 250
X-Quota-Reset: 1650000000
X-Quota-Scope: project
```
And for soft blocks return 429 + `Retry-After`.
Kevin (Eng): perf test requirement: add load test to ensure batching doesn't allow bypass of quotas. also add telemetry on quota decisions (quota_id, enforcement_type, precedence_applied).
Maria (PM): scope cuts for initial launch: only per-key and per-project quotas. defer per-route/per-model granularity to Q3. capture in PRD.
Samir (Billing): free tier behavior: prefer 429 for soft caps (with `Retry-After`) — free usage excluded from invoices. hard admin blocks return 403 and show `error.code=quota_exceeded_hard`.
Maria (PM): decision summary:
- Metering: explicit metrics (text_tokens, embeddings)
- Billing precedence: single metric billed per request (embeddings > text)
- Enforcement: soft = 429 + Retry-After; hard = 403
- API: /v1/quotas GET/PUT, compact payload; include quota headers
- UI: slider + overrides, CTA for limit increases, tooltip for precedence
- Launch: feature-flagged beta -> top-10 -> ramp, reconciliation 24h <=1%.
Elaine (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/456 (adds sample responses and headers)
Jordan (ProdOps): action items:
- @Elaine: add API schema PR by EOD Thu
- @Kevin: add load tests + batching guard
- @Samir: write billing precedence doc + 3 examples
- @Ashley: update tooltip copy and denial CTA
- @Maria: publish acceptance checklist and set feature flag
Kevin (Eng): ack. I'll annotate traces with `quota_id` and `enforcement_type` so we can query post-launch.
Samir (Billing): will confirm rounding: bill by ceil(usage/1000) units for tokens/embeddings. will post examples.
Ashley (Design): will update mocks and include denial screen with direct link to request increase.
Maria (PM): thanks — next sync Thurs 10am to sign off. :thumbsup:
